messages:
Sam: Hey @Alia — quick one. GreenGrid procurement asked for a SOC 2 Type II summary, ISO27001 attestation copy, and a signed pen-test letter for their vendor packet. We're kicking off the POC next week (Mon). Can we assemble a single bundle and ETA? Also they're asking for a ballpark Dedicated vs hosted pricing comparison for data residency. :pray:

Alia: Hi Sam — I can pull the SOC2 summary + control matrix. We only have an ISO attestation PDF (no cert number) — is that acceptable to them? For the pen-test letter we have a standard attestation template. Who should sign it on our side (security or legal)?

Sam: They want a company-level sig (procurement requirement). Suggested sig line: someone from Security or Legal. GreenGrid contact is Grace K (Legal). Also for pricing they asked for a monthly committed number for Dedicated (they want predictability) vs hosted per-token. Not final, just a rough comparator to unblock procurement.

Mike: For infra: Dedicated requires ~2–3 business days to reserve GPUs depending on region. Hosted can be live same day. For ballpark: reserved 4-GPU pool tends to sit around ~$14k–20k/mo depending on instance type; hosted is pay-as-you-go — I can pull more exact comps after lunch.

Rachel: Also note for audit evidence we can't share files over an open link. We need either a customer-provided SFTP/secure share or we'll generate a presigned S3 URL with tight expiry. @Alia can you confirm our preferred upload flow? 🙂

Alia: I'll stage artifacts in our secure bucket and generate a presigned URL (48h expiry). Pen-test letter template (please use and send to Legal for final sign):
```
Dear [Customer],

Redwood Inference confirms an external penetration test was completed on [DATE]. Scope: public API endpoints, orchestration plane, and customer-facing control surfaces. No critical or high-risk findings were observed in the last 12 months. Redwood maintains records of remediation and ongoing monitoring.

Signed,
Security Team, Redwood Inference
```
We'll need Legal to sign the final PDF for procurement acceptance.

AuditBot: ATTACHMENT: SOC2-summary-2025.pdf (internal link). Access: Sam, Mike, Rachel granted. NOTE: ISO-attestation.pdf flagged — requires NDA before external share.

Sam: Ack. Does GreenGrid have the NDA in place? I thought Legal had circulated ours but not sure GreenGrid accepted redlines. If NDA is done I can ask Grace to accept and we can share by Thursday. Target: deliver full bundle (SOC2 summary, ISO attestation, signed pen-test letter) by Fri EOD to keep their procurement timeline.

Alia: NDA is still pending a minor redline from GreenGrid. I'll ping @Grace and @Marc (our Legal) now. If they accept today I can generate presigned links and request signature by Thu.

Mike: One more thing on POC creds: please create a time-limited service account scoped to staging (no prod keys). We'll need token, allowed IP ranges, and a small sample dataset. Ops, can you set that up? @Rachel

Rachel: Yep — I'll spin up a staging org and create a service account with TTL 7 days, IP-restriction, and post credentials to the secure channel. ETA Wed AM.

Sam: Great — I'll update GreenGrid and ask for NDA turnaround. Thanks everyone :raised_hands: We'll reconvene if Legal needs anything else.
